caption_L1: Is there more crime in the U.S. than there was a year ago , or less ? is a line diagram. Along the y-axis, More is defined along a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8. The x-axis plots Year as a linear scale with a minimum of 1990 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: Crime was high in the 90s before dropping sharply in the early 2000s. Since then there has been a sharp rise, with a few dips over the years but never as low as the 2000 levels.
